name: ordan-crm-leads
description: Ordan Cargo Future Clients — extracts potential clients from HBL PDF files.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"

scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
